positions.description:
InsightCloudSec | Cloud Security Posture Management Service
- Expanded multiple microservices for the Host Vulnerability Management feature through (1) improved multi-layer data visibility, (2) enhanced in-progress assessment provisioning, and (3) newly integrated wizard design pattern (AWS, Azure, GCP, TypeScript, React)
- Leveraged Python and SQLAlchemy to create an API service facilitating seamless communication between micro services by pre-processing consolidated query results from various databases for direct consumption at the API endpoint

projects.title: Maroon: Packet Transfer
projects.description:
Maroon: Packet Transfer is a debugging application made specifically for the microprocessor being developed by NEPES. It is a Windows application made with C# and .NET framework, with API provided by Cypress. Some of its main feature includes:

1. Maroon monitors packets transferred in and out of the microprocessor (Prodigy Card) on windows computer.
2. Based on protocols, translate instructions written by user to hex and transfer the packet to Prodigy Card, then translate the packet coming in from the card so the user can understand the output. The instruction can be written with modification of the user's choice, where the user can modify specific byte if it is necessary, while utilizing default translation of the instruction.
3. Merge all the packets coming in from Prodigy card, which makes up an yuv raw file in 422 format.
4. Convert the yuv formatted file into bmp, which can now be displayed on computer.

This was a project to assist the hardware team of NEPES, so I was adding and removing features on Maroon to meet hardware team's need as development went on.
